texts.start:
👋 Hey {name}!
This is the OpusMusicAPI Manager bot. Generate your API key, check your usage, renew or revoke it, all from here.
🎵 Fast, cached YouTube audio for your Telegram music bots. ✦ What you can do here: ➨ Generate your API key ➨Check your usage stats ➨Renew your key ➨Test any song with /test song name ➨Read the API guide with /docs
👇 Tap a button below to continue.
texts.join_required: 🔒 Join required To generate your API key, please join our channel(s) first: {channels} Then tap ✅ I've Joined.
texts.join_error: ⚠️ I couldn't verify your channel membership right now. Please try again in a moment.
texts.join_still: You haven't joined all the channels yet!
texts.key_hidden: unavailable, revoke and generate a new key
texts.renew_nokey: You have no active key to renew.
texts.revoke_confirm: ⚠️ Revoke your API key? It will stop working immediately. You can generate a new one anytime.
texts.revoked: ⛔ Your API key has been revoked. Tap Generate New to create a fresh key.
texts.revoke_none: You have no active key to revoke.
texts.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
texts.user_revoked_by_owner: ⛔ Your API key was revoked by the admin. You can generate a fresh key anytime, or contact support if you think this is a mistake.
texts.owner_broadcast_usage: 📣 Broadcast Reply to any message (text, image, video) with /broadcast, or send /broadcast your text.
texts.owner_broadcast_busy: ⏳ A broadcast is already running. Please wait for it to finish.
texts.test_usage: 🎧 Test the API Usage: /test song name Example: /test kesariya I search the song, download it through the API and send it here. It uses your own key and daily quota (1 request), and the song is saved in the cache for instant re-streaming.
texts.test_wait: ⏳ Your previous /test is still running. Please wait for it to finish.
texts.test_nokey: 🔑 You need an API key first. Tap Generate API, then try /test song name again.
texts.test_expired: 🔴 Your API key has expired. Tap Renew Now, then try again.
texts.test_too_long: ⚠️ That song is longer than {minutes} minutes, /test skips it to save your quota. Try another name.
texts.test_src_fresh: ⬇️ Source: fresh download (saved to the cache for next time when the cache is on)
texts.test_err_limit: 🚫 Your daily limit is finished. It resets at midnight, check My API Key for the time.
texts.test_err_rate: ⏱ Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
texts.test_err_busy: 🚧 The server is busy right now. Try again in a few seconds. You were not charged.
texts.test_err_key: 🔑 Your API key is not valid. Open the key card and renew or generate a new one.
texts.test_err_generic:
⚠️ Could not finish: {reason}
If the download failed you were not charged.
texts.docs: 📚 How to use the API in your bot Base URL: {base_url} Send your key in the header X-API-Key. 1) Find a song (free) GET /v1/search?q=song name → video_id, title, duration 2) Get a token GET /v1/download?url=VIDEO_ID&type=audio → download_token (valid 5 min) 3) Get the audio GET /v1/stream/VIDEO_ID with header X-Download-Token → the audio file (1 request is charged here) Quick one-step: GET /download?url=VIDEO_ID&type=audio&api_key=KEY Check usage: GET /v1/me Try it here: /test song name Full guide with code: DOCS.md in the repository.
